sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) that includes <OneTimeUse/>. First login should succeed; second submission of identical assertion material must be rejected if OneTimeUse and replay protections are enforced.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_use_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_use_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replay of a OneTimeUse SAML assertion (same Assertion ID used twice).

sequence_description: I2 replay attempt by reusing the exact same SAML assertion ID across two SP-initiated flows but with a fresh RelayState/state each time. If Dex only binds replay protection to RelayState (or request ID) and not Assertion/@ID, the second login may incorrectly succeed.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML Assertion/@ID in a new SP-initiated flow (replay protection not enforced on assertion ID).

sequence_description: I2 replay attempt where the same OneTimeUse assertion is submitted twice, but the first session is revoked in between. Replay protection must be independent of session revocation; the second submission must still be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted replay of a OneTimeUse SAML assertion after revoking the first session (replay cache improperly tied to session lifecycle).

Implication: Dex accepted replay of the same OneTimeUse SAML assertion after revocation; replay cache may be session-scoped instead of assertion-scoped.

sequence_description: Test whether Dex's SAML assertion replay cache survives connector deletion/recreation. Replay the exact same Assertion/@ID across a connector cleanup + re-enable boundary; second acceptance would indicate replay protection is scoped only to connector instance lifetime (freshness violation). Uses two identities to satisfy multi-principal coverage.
description:
Assertion FAILED: userB_replay_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: userB_replay_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML Assertion/@ID after connector deletion/recreation; replay cache may be reset or scoped incorrectly, enabling reuse of one-time credential artifacts.

sequence_description: I5: Attempt to obtain effective permissions from a SAML assertion that omits the entire <Conditions> element (no audience/time bounds). Control login uses normal Conditions; attack login removes Conditions. Expect Dex to reject the no-Conditions assertion.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML assertion without <Conditions>, potentially granting permissions without upstream audience/time bounds (I5).

sequence_description: I5: Attempt to authenticate with a SAML assertion whose AudienceRestriction is for a different SP/audience. Control login uses normal audience; attack login uses a mismatched audience. Expect Dex to reject the wrong-audience assertion.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_wrong_aud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_wrong_aud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML assertion with mismatched AudienceRestriction, enabling cross-audience authorization (I5).

sequence_description: Test whether allowedGroups treats '*' as a wildcard (should be literal) and incorrectly allows any group membership, causing over-grant beyond BrokerPolicy(config). Includes control (no allowed group) and attack (random group) under allowedGroups=['*'].
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_control_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_control_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Control login unexpectedly succeeded even though allowedGroups=['*'] should be treated as literal '*' and control user did not present that exact group; indicates wildcard interpretation or mis-enforcement of BrokerPolicy(config).

sequence_description: Test whether allowedGroups treats '*' as a wildcard (should be literal) and incorrectly allows any group membership, causing over-grant beyond BrokerPolicy(config). Includes control (no allowed group) and attack (random group) under allowedGroups=['*'].
